title: Why Kaikōura should be on your South Island Road Trip itinerary | Kaikōura
lines: Kaikōura - A Destination for All Seasons

The town of Kaikōura has several attractions with a small-town feel – an excellent opportunity to experience the famous Kiwi hospitality. It's a destination worth visiting year-round with endless nature-filled activities great for any age.
If you want to stay within walking distance to the little downtown and just across the ocean, book a night at the Kaikōura Quality Suites , the Lobster Inn Lodge , or one of many mid-range motels.
